description: CPU MuJoCo reduced six-leg free-root model. Segment sizes, fixed muscle moment arms, and passive joint support are engineering hypotheses, not measured fly anatomy or a validated natural standing mechanism.

passive_support.notes: Numerical support term on the 42 articulated hinge joints. This is not measured fly joint stiffness and does not represent neural tonus. A 2025 preprint reports that passive elasticity alone is insufficient to explain natural standing.

geometry.thorax_notes: Hypothesized 1.8 mm long shell; inertia is that of a uniform ellipsoid at the declared body mass. This is not measured anatomical geometry.

tibia_flexor.notes: Positive tibia_pitch flexion sign is an engineering convention.

tarsus_levator.notes: Positive tarsus_pitch lift sign is an engineering convention.

sternal_anterior_rotator.notes: Yaw direction convention; not calibrated to attachment anatomy.

sternal_adductor.notes: Reduced coxa_roll adduction hypothesis; direction is an engineering convention.

pleural_remotor_abductor.notes: Reduced retraction plus abduction hypothesis across coxa_pitch and coxa_roll.

sternotrochanter.anatomical_action: trochanter extension/depression via the trochanter extensor tendon
sternotrochanter.numerical_proxy: Same fixed 63 micrometre magnitude as the reduced trochanter_extensor; sign follows the model's extension convention. Not a geometry-derived or measured arm.
sternotrochanter.omitted_route: The biological biarticular path crosses body-coxa; its secondary moment arms are not represented without attachment/routing geometry.
sternotrochanter.notes: Action-backed reduced femur_pitch extension surrogate. Fixed magnitude shared across legs is uncalibrated; the distinct trochanter link and biarticular routing are omitted.

femur_reductor.notes: Reduced femur adduction/reduction hypothesis on femur_roll.

tergotrochanter.anatomical_action: trochanter extension/depression via the shared trochanter extensor tendon
tergotrochanter.numerical_proxy: Same fixed magnitude as reduced trochanter_extensor; no isolated measured arm is claimed.
tergotrochanter.notes: Corrected from an unsupported femur_roll action to a reduced femur_pitch extension surrogate. Magnitude and mapping across legs remain uncalibrated.

long_tendon.notes: Distal tendon action collapsed to the tarsus_pitch axis.

long_tendon_tibia.notes: LTM1 channel label; simplified tibia_pitch path hypothesis.

long_tendon_femur.notes: LTM2 channel label; simplified femur_pitch path hypothesis.
